capabilities: Compacts aliased wikilinks to alias-only display
Shortens external link URLs by domain or hides them
Truncates long Markdown image alt text
Expands full link or alt text on cursor placement or click
extras: Alt-text compaction applies only to Markdown image embeds (![alt](link)), not wikilink embeds (![[image.png|alt]]); CJK characters count as 2 units toward the display length.
problem: Long note titles, URLs and image alt text clutter the editor and distract while typing.
summary: Editor plugin that shortens wikilinks, external links and image alt text in place, expanding them when the cursor rests on them.
